compiled_state.title: As a DSO consumer, I want all design-notes.md references retargeted to DESIGN.md and an audit command available, so that there is a single source of truth for design-system governance.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Retargets every reference to .claude/design-notes.md in plugins/dso/ to repo-root DESIGN.md. Ships the dso design-lint --report audit command and DESIGN-MD-REFERENCE.md documentation.
**Why**: After migration, DESIGN.md must be the single source of truth. Stale references to design-notes.md cause consumer confusion and broken read paths.
**Scope**:
- IN: Reference retargeting across all skills/agents/hooks/config, dso design-lint --report command, DESIGN-MD-REFERENCE.md documentation, /dso:quick-ref discoverability, config key update
- OUT: Migration script (draft-6), lint wrapper (draft-2)

## Done Definitions

- grep -rln 'design-notes' plugins/dso/ | grep -v migrate-design-notes-to-design-md returns no matches — all references are retargeted to DESIGN.md ← Satisfies: sc-5 (sc-5: "Single source of truth for DSO consumers and audit command")
- All consumers that previously read .claude/design-notes.md (design-review, brainstorm, roadmap, ui-discover, visual-evaluator, ui-designer agent, scale-inference, preplanning ui-designer-dispatch-protocol, prioritize-epics, onboarding conditional-paths) are updated to read repo-root DESIGN.md instead, with fallback to design-notes.md for unmigrated projects ← Satisfies: sc-5
- dso design-lint --report runs full-file lint across the repo on demand and emits a per-violation-class count to stdout ← Satisfies: sc-5
- plugins/dso/docs/DESIGN-MD-REFERENCE.md exists with a ## Pinned CLI Version heading documenting the pinned @google/design.md version and the audit command usage ← Satisfies: sc-5
  ← Validates Closure Check: "The file plugins/dso/docs/DESIGN-MD-REFERENCE.md exists and contains a ## Pinned CLI Version heading."
- The dso design-lint --report command is auto-discoverable via /dso:quick-ref ← Satisfies: sc-5
  ← Validates Closure Check: "grep -rln 'design-notes' plugins/dso/ | grep -v migrate-design-notes-to-design-md returns no matches."
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Retargeting scope] The grep-based verification must exclude the migration script and its test files; all other references must be retargeted.
- [Audit command] The --report flag distinguishes full-file audit mode from the diff-only enforcement mode used by the pre-commit hook.
- [Residual Reference] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents config key design.design_notes_path (defaults to .claude/design-notes.md). After migration, this key's default must change to DESIGN.md. validate-config.sh and read-config.sh also need updating.
- [Blast Radius] Retargeting touches 20+ files across 12+ skills/agents. Each consumer has different read logic. Coordinate with draft-6 migration to ensure tombstone fallback is consistent.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
